caption:
Mortgage rates are back above 7%. 🏠

Freddie Mac says the average 30-year fixed rate is 7.32% this week. A year ago it was 6.19%.

That's a big jump in the monthly payment on the same house.

Are you waiting to buy, or have you given up on it?
first_comment: Would you buy a home at 7%+? Yes or no 👇
